digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage LLM error handling
propositions: Mid-run exception handlers in gate_dispatch.py (produce_plan_review_verdict, _run_code_review_gate) for LLMInputRejectedError have no test coverage despite being reachable via batch-runner propagation
Container warm-call abort arm in container_stage._run_container has no direct test coverage and its reachability through the plan-review batch path is untested
Code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract (systemic errors are translated and absorbed upstream by CodeReviewBatchRunner) with no proven in-tree production raiser
New tests must demonstrate both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError trigger degraded verdicts with gate_error sidecar in plan-review and code-review arms
New tests must prove container warm-call abort is reachable and correctly raises (aborts fan-out) for both systemic error types vs degrading on non-systemic failures
